> Check whether the 404 came from CodeIgniter or from your web server.

If it is CodeIgniter's own styled "404 Page Not Found" page, the framework is running and no route matched, so look at `app/Config/Routes.php`, controller file naming, and whether auto-routing is enabled, since CodeIgniter 4 disables it by default. If it is a plain nginx or Apache 404, CodeIgniter never executed, so fix your rewrite rules and make sure the document root points at the `public` directory.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/codeigniter-404/
